plan.notes: Transcribed from the official Lincoln University 2026-2027 Academic Year Catalog (LU Catalog.pdf, '2026 – 2027 ACADEMIC YEAR CATALOG'). BA in Business Administration: 45 units General Education + 42 units General Business Administration (GBA) + 21 units concentration + 15 units electives = 123 units. Term layout follows the catalog's published 'SUGGESTED COURSE SEQUENCING FOR BA IN BA DEGREE PROGRAM'. Concentration shown is International Business (first-listed of five: International Business, Marketing, Entrepreneurship, Management Information Systems, Business Communications); the other four menus are quoted in the choice notes. The 13 generic GE slots decompose exactly into the catalog's named GE list: SCI 31, MATH --, SCI 10, 'HIST 10 or HIST 15', 'HIST -- or HUM --', PSYCH 10, HUM 10, 'ECON 10 or ECON 280', 'POLSCI 10 or SOCSCI 10', ENG 86, ENG 75, ENG 82, and ENG 77/99/170/271/280 (13x3=39, plus the sequenced MATH 10 and CS 10 = 45). The catalog's GE list says 'HIST 15' but the course-description catalog contains no course numbered HIST 15 (only HIST 15A/15B), so HIST 15A/15B are offered as the options. 'MATH --' is shown as MATH 15 (the standard second mathematics course). ECON 10 is the canonical pick for 'ECON 10 or ECON 280' because BA 125's published prerequisite is ECON 10. BA 290's catalog prerequisite is 'Senior standing' (not a course code); modeled with an empty prereq array. 'MATH 10 or MATH 15' style prerequisites are modeled as the plan's actual satisfying course (MATH 10). Elective slots are not term-sequenced in the catalog ('At least 15 units of elective courses to be chosen from the university catalog').
